subject: CST207
note: Mode A. Strict P003–P006 window. P006-Q24 is a choice pool with no single topic; no jump. See decisions for editorial choices.

decisions.P003-Q17: Flagged: D is the recorded model answer, but B is also true. Choose the RAM/ROM hierarchy explanation; do not certify or rewrite the answer.
decisions.P003-Q26: Equal 4/4: take the specific Von Neumann diagram; IEEE layouts have their own heading in the same unit.
decisions.P003-Q27: Equal 4/4, cross-unit: restoring division includes a worked process; BIU/EU remains in Unit 3.
decisions.P003-Q28: 3m definitions / 5m EAT: hit/miss heading covers both and prioritises timing.
decisions.P003-Q29: 3m mapping definition / 5m direct mapping and disadvantage: select the mapping block with the direct-placement trace.
decisions.P003-Q30: Equal 4/4: select the RISC/CISC comparison; 8086 addressing is in Unit 3.
decisions.P003-Q31: Equal 4/4: pipeline hazards are the first and heavier recurring cluster, with Flynn nearby.
decisions.P003-Q33: Flagged: choose two of TLB/DMA/VM. Two choices share the paging/TLB heading, so prefer that over DMA alone.
decisions.P003-Q34: 3m micro-operation / 5m microprogrammed control: the control-unit heading wins despite the Unit 1 subpart.
decisions.P004-Q1: The stem asks about stored programs, not Flynn; ignore the unrelated label segment.
decisions.P004-Q5: MOV immediate is an assembly operation, not a number representation question.
decisions.P004-Q16: Equal 4/4: Von Neumann is the named architecture; its heading links directly to the bus and processor–memory material.
decisions.P004-Q17: Equal 4/4: take the exact stack-expression code; instruction cycle also has a Unit 2 diagram.
decisions.P004-Q18: Equal 4/4: pick the specific minimum/maximum-mode diagram and explanation; addressing has a nearby heading.
decisions.P004-Q19: Equal 4/4: take the exact 80 ns EAT worked case, beside the mapping material. The shared label also serves hit-rate MCQs.
decisions.P004-Q20: Flagged: 4m RISC/CISC and one of two 4m short notes; the mandatory comparison is the only common destination.
decisions.P004-Q21: 2m biased exponent / 6m architecture and pinout: route to the 8086 DIP/BIU/EU material.
decisions.P004-Q22: Equal 4/4: the narrower IEEE single/double layout is the destination; Flynn remains in Unit 2.
decisions.P005-Q15: Equal 4/4: 8086 addressing has the exact mode examples; the architecture half is in Unit 1.
decisions.P005-Q17: 5m internal architecture / 3m interrupts: use the 8086 BIU/EU heading, not the interrupt heading.
decisions.P005-Q19: 5m mapping / 3m write policy: the mapping heading covers the larger part and both write policies.
decisions.P005-Q20: 3m fixed/floating / 2m signed encoding / 3m DMA: related Unit 1 parts total 5m; take the fixed-point and negative-number example, not the DMA extension.
decisions.P005-Q21: 3m pipeline concept / 5m hazards: the hazards/speedup heading covers both; duplicate label in P004 covers the same material at 4/4.
decisions.P005-Q22: Flagged: choose two of Vector/RISC Pipeline/Cache hit-miss; no unique pair. Use the most distinctive Vector Processor explanation, with a second option in the same unit.
decisions.P006-Q5: Flagged: MDR is the printed-key model answer; it is not a direct disk interface. Use the processor-memory register path, not a storage-device heading.
decisions.P006-Q6: Status bits are flags; select the 8086 FLAGS heading (with the general CF/OF distinction), not an RTL section.
decisions.P006-Q12: The immediate form is the operative addressing detail. The notation is generic, not native 8086 syntax.
decisions.P006-Q16: 3m stored program / 5m processor-memory connection. Label is shared with P005-Q8; keep the common Von Neumann heading and put a direct processor-memory link and register-path explanation at that landing.
decisions.P006-Q17: 2m definition / 6m examples: 8086 addressing heading immediately leads to eight worked forms.
decisions.P006-Q18: 2m pipelining / 3m RISC/CISC / 3m hazards: pipeline concepts plus hazards carry 5m; comparison follows in the same unit.
decisions.P006-Q19: 5m BIU/EU / 3m min/max: the 8086 architecture heading opens with the BIU/EU diagram and leads into the pinout/mode material.
decisions.P006-Q20: 5m direct cache mapping / 3m virtual memory: select cache mapping; VM has a separate anchor.
decisions.P006-Q21: Equal 4/4: the IEEE heading starts with the comparison table and leads into single/double layouts.
decisions.P006-Q22: 2m ASR / 6m Booth: use the Booth heading with the exact −11 × −9 trace.
decisions.P006-Q23: 2m instruction cycle / 6m functional control-memory diagram: choose the microprogrammed control heading and show both.
decisions.P006-Q24: No jump, no topic. This unlabelled choice pool combines four topics across two units. Leave the stored unit overview and never highlight a practice section.
